source.title: Janalakshmi scales with Salesforce to reach more of the urban poor

source_facts.fact: Field representatives use a custom mobile application to capture leads and service customers.
Onboarding connects loan application to disbursement.
Mobile biometrics support customer verification and transaction authentication.
The customer platform integrates with a core banking system.
Loan disbursement and collection can occur at the customer's location.
Management reporting can drill into approval and transaction data by geography.

validation_extensions.scenario: Repeated offline replay of synthetic Lead, verification, and collection requests creates each fact once.
Duplicate synthetic identity enrollment enters merge review and cannot produce two disbursable customers.
A late biometric success reconciles without contradictory decisions.
The loan initiator cannot approve the same application and denial is audited.
Remote core-banking disbursement success remains pending reconciliation and cannot be sent twice.
Partial, late, and duplicate collection events update one repayment schedule without duplicate ledger entries.
Two workers compete for a due collection and only one owns execution.

synthetic_data_policy: Use fictional borrowers, identity tokens, biometric decisions, loan amounts, account numbers, and locations; never store real PII or financial records.
